title: 第5章 神秘道骨第6章 镇压朱刚
content_zh:
叶祈安听后回头看向青衣长老，眼神微眯，他能感觉到这个长老比前面的黑袍长老强得多。
抿嘴微微作揖说道:
“这位长老，何事？”
那青衣长老见状摸了摸发白的胡须，点点头。
不卑不亢，不骄不躁，光是这两点就超越了在场众多的新生弟子。
“叶平安...好名字。”
“你...通过了苍澜学院的新生考核。”
“从现在开始就正式是苍澜学院外院弟子。”
什么？！
众新生弟子纷纷侧目露出不可置信的表情。
就连叶祈安本人都不清楚发生了什么事。
青衣长老对着黑袍长老轻声说道。
“陈长老，结束考核吧，事后工作你安排好。”
那黑袍长老脸色铁青，皱着眉头犹豫片刻后说道：“李长老，您这么做不太妥当吧？”
“放肆！”
此话一出，整个考核广场皆笼罩在无尽的威压当中。
叶祈安见状双眼微眯。
“天元境！”
看来地位是要比这个黑袍老头陈长老高上不少。
只见无比庞大的威压瞬间就将陈长老压的动弹不得。

“李长老恕罪，是我冒犯了。”
闻言，他这才收起威压。
李长老冷哼一声这才御剑离开。
叶祈安看着他离开若有所思。
这长老为什么对自己走这个后门？
难道他刚刚看出了我的白色道骨的不同？
陈长老阴沉着脸色看向下方新生弟子。
“现在开始念到名字的是外门杂役弟子。”
“徐萍，林志议....”
被念到名字的弟子皆是垂头丧气，没有办法，他们虽说不是白色道骨，也通过了考核，也仅仅是倒数第二的青色道骨。
终其一生也就地元境后期或者半步天元境就已经是极限了。
“唉，我怎么会是杂役弟子啊，长老，会不会是弄错了。”
“嘘，你可别说话了，没看陈长老脸色吗？”
当陈长老念到最后一个名字时，他冷笑的看了一眼叶祈安。
“叶平安，杂役弟子！”
content_en:
After hearing this, Ye Qian turned back to look at the elder in green, his eyes narrowed slightly. He could feel that this elder was much stronger than the elder in black robe in front of him.
He pursed his lips and bowed slightly, saying:
"Elder, what's the matter?"
Seeing this, the elder in green touched his white beard and nodded.
Neither humble nor arrogant, neither arrogant nor impetuous, these two points alone surpassed the many new disciples present.
"Ye Pingan...a good name."
"You...passed the freshman examination of Canglan College."
"From now on, I am officially a disciple of Canglan Academy's outer court."
What? !
All the new disciples looked sideways with expressions of disbelief.
Even Ye Qian himself didn't know what happened.
The elder in green robe said softly to the elder in black robe.
"Elder Chen, please finish the assessment and make arrangements for the work afterwards."
The black-robed elder's face was livid, he frowned and hesitated for a moment before saying, "Elder Li, is it not appropriate for you to do this?"
"Presumptuous!"
As soon as these words came out, the entire assessment square was shrouded in endless pressure.
Ye Qi'an narrowed his eyes slightly when he saw this.
"Tianyuan Realm!"
It seems that his status is much higher than that of the old man in black robe, Elder Chen.
The extremely huge pressure instantly suppressed Elder Chen and made him unable to move.
"Elder Li, please forgive me. I was the one who offended you."
Hearing this, he put away his pressure.
Elder Li snorted before Yu Jian left.
Ye Qian watched him leave thoughtfully.
Why did this elder take this backdoor to him?
Did he just see the difference in my white bones?
Elder Chen looked down at the new disciples with a gloomy expression.
"The person whose name is being read now is the servant disciple from the outer sect."
"Xu Ping, Lin Zhiyi..."
The disciples whose names were read were all dejected and had no choice. Although they were not white Taoist bones, they had passed the examination and were only the second to last cyan Taoist bones.
Remaining at the late stage of Diyuan Realm or half step of Tianyuan Realm throughout his life is already the limit.
"Hey, how can I be a handyman disciple? Elder, could it be a mistake?"
"Shh, stop talking. Didn't you look at Elder Chen's face?"
When Elder Chen read the last name, he glanced at Ye Qian with a sneer.
"Ye Pingan, handyman disciple!"
